scenes.event: Sienna confronts her project partner Rose about the incomplete science project.
scenes.description: The school library is quiet, with only the sound of typing and occasional shuffling of papers. Sienna sits at a table with her laptop open, surrounded by notebooks and materials for their upcoming science project. Rose is lounging on a chair, scrolling on her phone, while Tiki, a mutual friend, sits nearby, trying to mediate.

characters.name: Sienna Simpson
characters.description: 17-year-old high school student, serious and determined, visibly stressed over the project.; Female, High School Student, 17 years old; Occupation: High School Student; Personality: Serious, Determined, Irritable; Values: Integrity, Sense of responsibility, Pursuit of excellence; Interests: Science projects, Teamwork, Academic success; Experiences: Participating in group projects, Dealing with unreliable partners, Handling deadline pressure
characters.position: At the table, focused on her laptop.

characters.name: Rose Carter
characters.description: 17-year-old high school student, laid-back and indifferent, shows no urgency about the project; Female; Age: 17; Occupation: High school junior; Personality: Nonchalant, easygoing, procrastinatory; Values: Comfort, social harmony, minimal effort; Interests: Binge-watching TV shows, casual gaming, trending social media challenges; Experiences: Last-minute cramming for exams, being reprimanded by teachers for missed deadlines, relying on friends to cover for unfinished work.
characters.position: On a chair, casually scrolling on her phone.

characters.name: Tiki Nguyen
characters.description: 17-year-old high school student, friendly and empathetic, trying to ease the tension between Sienna and Rose; Male; Age: 17; Occupation: High school junior; Personality: Compassionate, tactful, observant; Values: Friendship, responsibility, fairness; Interests: Music production, environmental science, reading graphic novels; Experiences: Mediated a few group conflicts in class projects, worked part-time at a local bookstore during summer break, organized a school-wide recycling initiative.
characters.position: Sitting next to Sienna, offering support.

actions.action: Sighs and closes her laptop, turning to Rose.
actions.dialogue: Rose, we only have 24 hours left before the project is due, and you haven’t even started the data analysis. I can’t keep covering for you.

actions.action: Looks up from her phone with a shrug.
actions.dialogue: I’ll get to it. It’s not like it’s the end of the world if it’s a little late.

actions.action: Attempts to mediate by speaking to both.
actions.dialogue: Come on, Rose, you know how much this project means to Sienna. Let’s just work it out together.

actions.action: Crosses her arms, her voice firm.
actions.dialogue: I can’t keep doing this, Tiki. I value teamwork, but I can’t compromise on the quality of our work because Rose refuses to take it seriously.

actions.action: Rolls her eyes and says sarcastically.
actions.dialogue: Okay, drama queen. You can just do it all by yourself if it’s so important to you.
Yes, I will. I have a sense of responsibility, and I won’t let this project fail because of someone else’s laziness.

actions.action: Looks uneasy, trying to find a way to help.
actions.dialogue: Maybe I can help with the analysis if you want, Rose? I don’t want to see either of you fail.

scenes.plot: Sienna is preparing to finish the science project alone after Rose’s repeated lack of effort, while Tiki tries to find a compromise to prevent the group from falling apart.
scenes.social_purpose: To show Sienna’s sense of duty and pursuit of excellence in the face of Rose’s irresponsibility, and to highlight the impact of such friction on group dynamics and future collaboration.

chunk.text: The confrontation in the library sets the stage for Sienna’s decision to take full responsibility for the project, despite the growing tension with Rose and the uncertainty of future teamwork.
